kurz: Salt draws water out of vegetables, and you can watch it happen.
bild_im_kopf: Like a magnet for water: wherever the salt is, water is drawn to it.
beobachtung: Drops of water appear on the salted slices, liquid collects on the plate and the slices turn bendy.
erklaerung: Water moves to where there is more salt ([[osmose|osmosis]]). That is why freshly salted meat is wet, and why you should fry it either straight away or much later.
schritte: Cut the vegetable into slices of equal thickness and divide them between two plates.
Salt one plate but not the other.
